units.source_text: 二条院的东院修建工事已毕，源氏内大臣教花散里迁居在这东院中的西殿和廊房里。

en.t: The construction work on the east wing of the Nijo residence was complete, and Genji, the Inner Minister, had Hanachirusato move into the west hall and the corridor rooms of that east wing.

units.source_text: 家务办事处及家臣住所，也都做了应有的安置。

en.t: The household offices and the retainers' quarters were also arranged as they should be.
The east hall was intended as a residence for the Lady of Akashi.

units.source_text: 北殿特别宽广，凡以前一时结缘而许以终身赡养的女人，他准备教她们集中在这北殿里，因此隔成许多房间。

en.t: The north hall was especially spacious; for the women with whom he had once formed ties and promised lifelong support, he planned to gather them there, and so he divided it into many rooms.

units.source_text: 但也设备得非常周到，处处精雅可爱。

en.t: Even so, the fittings were extremely well considered, and every part was refined, elegant, and charming.

units.source_text: 正殿空着，作为自己偶尔来住时休息之所，故也有种种适当的设备。

en.t: The main hall was left empty as a place where he could rest when he occasionally came to stay, so it too was furnished with various suitable arrangements.
